ACTIVITY DIAGRAM · AS-IS · ONE MONTHLY CYCLE, END TO END

Travel-cost reimbursement — from the participant's ticket to the payment record

Nine actors. The left half is the collection and calculation work the Admin carries alone; the right half is the approval chain that starts once the packet is scanned. Solid lines are hand-offs, red lines are returns. Only the KST 0098 detail check can send work back to the Admin — everything rejected later stops at 0098.
